profile.ja: 藤美学園3年生。2年生時に全国大会で優勝した実力を持つ剣道部主将。古武術の道場主である父親の教えを受けて剣の道へ進む。常にクールな彼女は一行のサブリーダーにしてまとめ役。その一方で、料理が得意など家庭的な面も見せる。
profile.en: She is a third-year student at Fujimi Academy. As captain of the kendo club, she won the national tournament in her second year. She follows the path of the sword, taught by her father who runs a classical martial-arts dojo. Always cool, she serves as the sub-leader and organizer of the group, and she also shows a homely side, being good at cooking.

text.ja: 毒島冴子だ。戦闘に関してはそれなりに自信がある。期待してくれていいよ、隊長
text.en: I'm Saeko Busujima. I'm fairly confident when it comes to combat. You can expect great things from me, Captain.

text.ja: これが対魔忍スーツか……ふふ、動きやすいし、何よりデザインが私好みだ。気に入ったよ
text.en: So this is the Taimanin suit… hehe, it's easy to move in, and the design is right up my alley. I like it.

text.ja: ここには達人が大勢いる上に、流派だけではなく独自の戦闘コンセプトを持っている。だが、皆実戦の為だという点は共通しているな
text.en: There are a lot of masters here, and they each have their own fighting concepts beyond just their schools. But they all share one thing: they train for real combat.

text.ja: そうか、対魔忍の長も剣術使いなのか。是非一度手合わせをしてみたい。ん？　そんな驚くような事を言ったかな？
text.en: I see, even the head of the Taimanin uses swordsmanship. I'd love to spar with them sometime. Huh? Did I say something that surprised you?

text.ja: 戦いになるとどうしても昂ぶってしまう。そして、力に酔い、奮うことを楽しむ……それが私の本質なんだ
text.en: When a fight starts I can't help getting fired up. I get drunk on power and enjoy the thrill… that's just who I am.

text.ja: この刀か？　小銃兼正・村田刀、高城の父上から頂いた物だ。切れ味もさることながら、その堅牢さには助けられている
text.en: This sword? It's the Murata blade—a rifle-katana I received from Takashi Takashiro's father. Its sharpness is superb, and its durability has saved me many times.

text.ja: よく人違いをされるんだが、後ろ姿が似ているそうだ。ん？　心当たりがあるのか……ふむ、そこまで似ているなら会ってみたいな
text.en: People often mistake me for someone else because my back looks similar. Huh? You think you know who? …If we really look that alike, I'd like to meet them.

text.ja: 同じ年頃の学生も多いのに、皆戦う覚悟ができているな。この環境にいれば強くなるのも道理……というところか
text.en: Even though many of them are just students our age, they're all ready to fight. Being in this environment naturally makes you stronger… that's the idea.
